headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Dynamic.xyz documentation spans 2,286 crawled pages with 100% crawl coverage. Critical issues include 61 confirmed broken internal links across user-facing docs, 20.13% SEO/GEO issue rate, and only 3.37% of pages displaying last-updated metadata. API reference coverage is 66.67% across 1,534 detected API pages. Example reliability detection returned 0%, indicating a likely JS-rendering detection gap rather than true absence of code examples. Retrieval readiness scores 73.86 (moderate band), with 68.64% stale-risk flagged pages and only 11.71% of 333 key claims backed by evidence.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Documentation freshness debt
key_findings.business_consequence: Prioritize stale pages via weekly SLA loop and lifecycle policies.

priority_actions.title: Fix all 61 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing docs
priority_actions.why_this_first: Immediate trust and SEO recovery across 61 link instances with minimal engineering effort, directly reducing support escalations and bounce rate.

priority_actions.title: Add last-updated timestamps to all 2,286 pages (currently 3.37% coverage) via automated frontmatter injection from Git history
priority_actions.why_this_first: Reduces stale-risk perception from 68.64% and enables users and LLMs to filter fresh content, improving answer quality and user confidence with one-time automation.

priority_actions.title: Remediate SEO/GEO issues on the 20.13% flagged pages (~460 pages) focusing on missing meta descriptions, title tags, and heading structure
priority_actions.why_this_first: Unlocks organic search traffic growth and improves discoverability for ~460 pages, directly impacting top-of-funnel acquisition within 30 days.

strengths: Complete crawl coverage at 100% (2,286 of 2,369 requested pages indexed)
High citationability at 99.87% and answerability at 98.64%, supporting AI retrieval use cases
1,534 API pages detected with 66.67% reference coverage, indicating substantial API surface documentation
risks: 61 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing docs degrade trust, SEO authority, and user navigation success
20.13% SEO/GEO issue rate threatens organic discoverability and search ranking across ~460 pages
68.64% stale-risk pages (1,569 pages) may contain outdated information, eroding user confidence and AI answer quality
Only 3.37% last-updated coverage (77 pages) prevents users and LLMs from assessing content freshness
limitations: External audit cannot verify content technical accuracy, correctness of code examples, or alignment with current product behavior.
21 unverified links due to authentication, rate limiting, or server blocks may include false negatives; manual review required for final link health assessment.

0% example reliability likely reflects JS-rendered code block detection limitation rather than true absence; client-side rendering prevents automated code extraction and testing without instrumentation changes.
automation_first: Deploy CI link checker to catch broken internal links before publish: 61 confirmed broken links currently degrade trust and SEO; automated pre-publish validation prevents recurrence and eliminates manual audits, saving ~4 hours/week and protecting user experience.

Automate last-updated timestamp injection from Git commit history for all 2,286 pages: only 3.37% currently show freshness metadata, leaving 2,209 pages opaque; Git-based automation delivers 100% coverage in one sprint and directly reduces the 68.64% stale-risk perception, improving RAG answer filtering and user confidence.

Implement automated SEO/GEO linting in CI for meta descriptions, title tags, and heading hierarchy: 20.13% issue rate (~460 pages) blocks organic discovery; pre-publish linting prevents new violations and provides fix suggestions, reducing manual SEO audits by ~6 hours/month and protecting search ranking.
